Explore AR Mine
Mission & Background

Transforming High-Risk Industry with Spatial Intelligence

AR Mine was conceived with a single guiding mission: to replace static 2D paper manuals with real-time, hands-free Augmented Reality overlays that keep industrial workers safe in hazardous environments.

PROJECT CONTEXT

The Industrial Safety Challenge

Industrial environments such as underground mines and high-output manufacturing plants remain among the most dangerous operating environments in the modern world. In these sectors, accidents rarely happen because workers do not care about safety—they happen because hazards are dynamic, complex, and invisible until it is too late.

Traditional safety training predominantly relies on classroom sessions, printed instruction binders, warning plaques, and theoretical videos. While vital, these mediums suffer from a critical limitation: cognitive detachment. When a worker faces an emergency 200 meters underground, they cannot pause to flip through a binder.

"See the Risk. Understand the Environment. Work Safer."

— AR Mine Core Philosophy
SOLUTION ARCHITECTURE

The AR Mine Solution

AR Mine bridges this gap by merging digital safety intelligence with the worker's direct field of view. By leveraging optical sensors, computer vision tagging, and spatial anchors, the system projects:

  • Active Hazard Perimeters: Real-time visual boundaries around moving equipment, toxic zones, and structural fault lines.
  • Holographic SOP Overlays: Step-by-step disassembly, maintenance, and inspection guidance displayed directly over machinery parts.
  • Dynamic Evacuation Guidance: Luminous virtual waypoints pointing toward safe refuge bays through smoke, low light, or dust.
Zero Paper Delays
Spatial Contextual Precision
Instant Hazard Warnings
